scope: Original positions within the benchmark pool depth, including repeated URLs; never missing result slots or failed calls
characters: Unicode code points, preserving returned whitespace and repetition; sum field lengths without artificial separators
words: Whitespace-separated chunks; descriptive only, not model tokens or language-independent linguistic words
snippets: Primary snippet and all additional snippet strings; titles and metadata excluded; primary and additional lengths also reported separately
percentiles: Nearest-rank percentile on all measured returned positions, including zero length for absent or empty snippet text
metadata: Nonempty native metadata entries excluding mechanical rank/position/index and duplicate date aliases; supplied date metadata is availability, not validated publication/event proof
quality: Own result grades; raw position counts, not family-weighted nDCG. Unknown and ungraded counts remain separate. Length associations are retrospective and confounded by provider, query, rank and duplicate mix
